name: Demand Forecast Calculator
summary: Forecasts demand from your history with a named method (moving average, exponential smoothing or naive) and tests its accuracy.
description: Produces a baseline demand forecast from your historical numbers using the method and parameters you choose: a moving average, simple exponential smoothing or the naive last-value method. When there are at least 8 historical periods it holds back the most recent ones, measures MAE, RMSE and MAPE, and compares the method with the naive baseline; with less history it says no accuracy can be claimed. Who it's for: operations, supply chain and finance teams who need a transparent baseline forecast. Limitations: all three methods produce a flat forecast with no trend, seasonality or external drivers; the forecast is a calculation from your history, not a prediction by the model.
problems: Forecast next month's demand from our sales history
I need a simple baseline demand forecast
How accurate is a moving average forecast for our data
